title: Ultrafast and Accurate Selection of High-Quality Protein Complex Models from Large-Scale Prediction
authors: Liang F; Xie L; Ye E; Pan Z; Xu T; Wang H; Wei P; Liu J; Zhang G
one_liner_zh: 该文提出DeepUMQA-Selection两阶段框架，结合单模型精度估计与基于USR的超快结构比对，从大规模候选池中高效准确筛选高质量蛋白复合物模型，属于蛋白质结构预测后处理与模型选择的核心计算问题，方法创新且性能显著。
abstract: In the post-AlphaFold era, advances in protein complex structure prediction have enabled the generation of thousands of candidate models per target, making the accurate and efficient selection of high-quality models from large candidate pools a critical challenge. Existing model-selection approaches commonly employ estimated model accuracy (EMA) methods, which include single-model and consensus-based methods. The former lack cross-model comparative information, whereas the latter often incur high computational costs from pairwise structural alignments and are influenced by candidate-pool quality. Here, we present DeepUMQA-Selection, a two-stage framework combining single-model accuracy estimators for preliminary selection with Ultrafast Shape Recognition (USR)-based structural alignment for consensus selection. Preliminary selection enriches the candidate pool with high-quality models and reduces subsequent structural comparisons, while USR-based structural alignment enables efficient consensus selection without explicit structural superposition. On the retrospective CASP16 QMODE3 benchmark dataset, DeepUMQA-Selection outperformed all participating methods and predictor-derived confidence metrics, as measured by mean Top-5 weighted penalty. The advantage was particularly pronounced for heteromeric targets, with a 13.9% improvement in model-selection performance relative to the best-performing CASP16 participating method. Furthermore, a confidence-assisted strategy enabled the framework to accommodate larger protein complexes while maintaining superior model-selection performance over competing methods, supporting its scalability. Runtime benchmarking showed that the proposed USR-based structural alignment achieved a substantial 317-fold speedup over US-align for candidate pools containing 1,000 models, demonstrating its computational efficiency for large-scale model selection. Our results demonstrate that DeepUMQA-Selection enables accurate and computationally efficient selection of high-quality protein complex models from large-scale candidate pools.
abstract_zh: 在后AlphaFold时代，蛋白质复合物结构预测的进展使得每个靶标能够生成数千个候选模型，因此从大型候选池中准确且高效地选择高质量模型成为一项关键挑战。现有的模型选择方法通常采用估计模型精度（EMA）方法，包括单模型方法和基于共识的方法。前者缺乏跨模型的比较信息，而后者往往因成对结构比对而产生高昂的计算成本，并受候选池质量的影响。在此，我们提出DeepUMQA-Selection，这是一个两阶段框架，结合了单模型精度估计器用于初步筛选，以及基于超快形状识别（USR）的结构比对用于共识选择。初步筛选丰富了候选池中的高质量模型并减少了后续的结构比较，而基于USR的结构比对则无需显式结构叠加即可实现高效的共识选择。在回顾性CASP16 QMODE3基准数据集上，DeepUMQA-Selection在平均Top-5加权惩罚方面优于所有参与方法及预测器衍生的置信度指标。这一优势在异源多聚体靶标中尤为显著，相对于表现最佳的CASP16参与方法，模型选择性能提升了13.9%。此外，一种置信度辅助策略使该框架能够适应更大的蛋白质复合物，同时保持优于竞争方法的模型选择性能，支持其可扩展性。运行时基准测试表明，所提出的基于USR的结构比对在包含1000个模型的候选池中，相对于US-align实现了显著的317倍加速，展示了其在大规模模型选择中的计算效率。我们的结果表明，DeepUMQA-Selection能够从大规模候选池中准确且计算高效地选择高质量蛋白质复合物模型。
